crossRefs.note: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…

parallels.note: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak…

translations.web: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
translations.bsb: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
translations.kjv: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
translations.asv: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write them to thee with ink and pen:
